dsh-liquid-glass is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Wallpaper plus optional Liquid Glass islands for the DSH Web UI: Ice/Deepwater presets, import, wallpaper opacity, and per-island blur on official light/dark/system.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-eefed04d5798e36bebc9.html
